package.name: fr3_mating_controllers
package.description: Cartesian-impedance insertion backend for the connector-mating cell: a franka_ros2 ControllerInterface plugin running the 1 kHz torque loop tau = J^T (K dx - D v) + nullspace + coriolis, with tool-frame stiffness (soft lateral X/Y + roll/pitch, firm along tool Z) so the connector self-aligns into its socket under contact. Builds only where the franka_ros2 stack is present (see CMakeLists).
